connector.name: Eterna MCP
connector.registryDescription: No-KYC managed MCP for AI agents: sandboxed TypeScript trading SDK, isolated sub-accounts, futures.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.eterna.exchange over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the eternahybridexchange account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token from OAuth (ai-auth) or agent API key after register_agent. See https://github.com/EternaHybridExchange/eterna-mcp/blob/main/docs/authentication.md
